scope: Finite abstract protocol models; no production Rust refinement proof
Publication model: exactly two one-shot transactions, two rows, two nonzero keys; one index with one or two publication buckets
Publication/durability enumerate all interleavings in explicit finite one-shot configurations; no depth/state constraints
Exact snapshot row materialization is assumed; allocator, process-sharing and weak-memory implementations are not modeled
Durability.tla retains historical candidate-ordering models; CheckpointCut.tla models the implemented partition-exclusion plus active-cut alternative, still without Rust refinement
Resource pilots use finite cyclic scenario abstractions with explicitly stated weak fairness; conditional liveness only, no general timestamp-abstraction or Rust-refinement proof

PrimaryKeyInsert models two one-shot insertions into one append-only bucket, same-key exclusion and distinct colliding keys; captured-chain search/CAS and row-ID reservation are abstract primitives, not a Rust refinement

PredicatePublication adds two repeated equality lookups, local insert/move/delete overlay, a one-shot older writer, and separate post-deregister publication stamps; exact pinned MVCC and raw candidate capture remain abstract primitives

LifecyclePublication splits reserve/register under lifecycle exclusion, captures snapshot active IDs/xmax, and derives late publication ordering with one or two bucket guards; two one-shot transactions, no machine wrap or native atomic refinement

toolchain.note: The SHA-256, not the mutable release tag alone, identifies the tested binary. Download is explicit and checksum mismatch is fatal.
